lines.trans: Oh no!
I just searched Xin Huimei, and on Weibo right now there is a video of that day.
The reposts are already close to a thousand.
I am afraid they have already passed ten thousand.
Xin Huimei reposted the Weibo, and even liked it.
Who is Bianbian?
There is an entertainment reporter named Bianbian, who wrote Xin Huimei reposting the Weibo into a news article.
It has already been pushed to the front page of Lutiao Network.
A coordinated series of actions, all colluded in advance.
It seems this matter will disturb even more people.
